name: OVHcloud AI Endpoints
short: European serverless inference platform serving open models through an OpenAI-compatible API, with keyless free access.

plans.name: Anonymous free access
plans.notes: Try models without an account or API key: 2 requests/minute per IP and per model.

plans.name: Free trial
plans.notes: Public Cloud Free Trial: US$200 credit for a first project, valid one month, covering the free-tier AI API trial.

plans.name: Pay as you go
plans.notes: No commitment, per-token catalog pricing (e.g. Qwen 3.8 27B at €0.40/M input, €2.70/M output); 400 requests/minute per project and per model with an access key.
